content: Miconazole buccal tablets, commonly marketed under the brand name Oravig, are prescribed for the treatment of fungal infections in the mouth or throat. This medication belongs to the azole class of antifungal drugs, which work by inhibiting the growth of fungi. Administration Instructions: 1. Preparation and Placement: Before using the tablet, ensure you have read the patient information leaflet and instructions provided by your pharmacist. This medication is typically used once daily in the morning after brushing your teeth. Identify the area in your mouth where the tablet will be placed—specifically, the upper gum above either the left or right incisor tooth (the teeth adjacent to your two front teeth). 2. Application: With dry hands, place the tablet in your mouth with the rounded side facing your gum. Gently press it into place. Remove your hand from your mouth and apply slight pressure to the outside of your upper lip for 30 seconds to ensure the tablet adheres to your gum. 3. Dissolution: Leave the tablet in place until it dissolves completely, which usually takes about 6 hours or longer. You may eat and drink while the tablet is in place, but avoid chewing gum. Do not crush, chew, or swallow the tablet. 4. Monitoring: After brushing your teeth, rinsing your mouth, eating, or drinking, check to ensure the tablet is still in place. Before applying the next dose, remove any remaining pieces of the previous tablet. If the tablet falls off or does not stick within the first 6 hours, reapply it as directed. If it still does not adhere, replace it with a new tablet. However, if the tablet falls off or is accidentally swallowed after 6 hours, do not apply a new dose. Important Considerations: Consistency: Antifungal medications are most effective when the drug concentration in your body is maintained at a constant level. Continue using the medication for the full prescribed duration, even if symptoms improve after a few days. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Side Effects: Common side effects include discomfort, sores, taste changes, or irritation/pain in the mouth. Gastrointestinal symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, or headache may also occur. Serious allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis, are rare but possible. Seek immediate medical attention if you experience symptoms such as rash, itching/swelling (especially of the face/tongue/throat), severe dizziness, or difficulty breathing. Precautions: Inform your doctor if you are allergic to miconazole or any other azole antifungal agents. This product may contain inactive ingredients, such as milk protein concentrate, which can cause allergic reactions or other issues. Use during pregnancy should only occur if clearly needed, as there is limited data on its safety in pregnant women. It is unknown whether this drug passes into breast milk, so consult your doctor if you are breastfeeding. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of miconazole or increase the risk of side effects. Maintain a list of all medications and supplements you are taking and share it with your healthcare provider. Overdose: In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services immediately (911 in the U.S.). For non-emergency overdoses, contact a poison control center (1-800-222-1222 in the U.S.). Storage: Store the medication at room temperature, away from moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Properly discard expired or unused medication as instructed by your pharmacist. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless directed to do so. Additional Notes: This medication has been prescribed specifically for your current condition. Do not share it with others or use it for other infections unless directed by your doctor. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this medication and your specific health needs.
